# Roblox Claim Review Intake Site

## Purpose

This site is an informational legal intake landing page for families requesting review of Roblox-related consumer concerns.

## Covered Topics

- Unauthorized Roblox or Robux charges
- Refund concerns
- Parental-control issues
- Account safety questions
- Child-safety concerns
- Unsafe user interactions
- Inappropriate content exposure

## Legal Notice

This is attorney advertising and informational content. The site does not provide legal advice, does not guarantee compensation, does not guarantee representation, and does not create an attorney-client relationship through form submission alone.

## Primary Page

- Homepage: https://paisabrazilfl-cpu.github.io/BRENT-SITES-/

## Intake Flow

The site collects parent or guardian contact information, state, issue type, and a summary. Production teams should connect the endpoint in `assets/app.js` to a secure backend, CRM, or webhook.
